integrity: The fixed-space formulas are proved by a complete structural parametrization and determinant/eigenspace stratification. Exhaustive computations are consistency checks rather than evidence for the universal quantifier.
scientific_limitations: Rank two and odd characteristic only; no automorphism conjugacy classification is claimed. Finite verification uses prime fields, while the proof covers all odd prime powers.
title: Fixed-space spectrum of automorphisms of the two-generator exterior algebra over odd finite fields
